           OLEUM SANTALI

         Oil of Sandalwood


The action in the urinary and sexual spheres is most utilizable,
        especially in gonorrhœa. It is also a stimulating, disinfectant expectorant. Two or three
        drops on sugar will frequently relieve the hacking cough, when but little sputum is
        expectorated.



Male.--  Painful erections; swelling of the prepuce. Thick,
        yellowish, muco-purulent discharge. Deep pain in perineum.



Urine.--  Frequent, burning, smarting swelling, and redness of
        meatus. Stream small and slow.   Acute aching in kidney region  .
        Sensation of a ball pressing against the urethra; worse, standing. Gleet, with profuse,
        thick discharge; chronic cystitis.



Dose.--  Two to ten m in capsules.
